description: This source file contains functions for file handling operations such as opening, reading, writing, and manipulating filenames in a C project. It provides utility functions to interact with files, handle errors, and process filenames for a Lua-based environment.

methods.name: char * lu5_name_without_extention(const char * filename)
methods.description: Removes the extension from a filename and returns a new string without the extension.

methods.name: FILE * lu5_open_file(const char * path,const char * mode)
methods.description: Opens a file with specified mode, handling errors via Lua or logging mechanisms.

methods.name: int lu5_write_file(const char * path,const void * buffer,size_t len)
methods.description: Writes a buffer of data to a file at a given path.

methods.name: char * lu5_read_file(const char * path,long * size)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into a buffer, returning the size via a pointer.
